senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. זהה) [to be glistening; cmp. צחן a. צחח)] to be filthy, smell offensively, be offensive.—Part. זוֹהֵם, or part. pass. זָהוּם.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:7:7">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>ר״ל אמר ככוס ז׳</he> (not <he>בכוס</he>) R. L. says, It is like drinking out of an offensive cup; <he>השותה בכוס ז׳ וכ׳</he> he who drinks (sacred wine &c.) out of &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Niddah 4:1:2">Y. Nidd. IV, end, 51ᵇ</cite> <he>דם נידה זהום</he> (<cite ref="Tosefta Niddah 9:10">Tosef. ib. IX, 10</cite> <he>זוהם</he>; Bab.
<cite ref="Niddah 65b:56">Nidd. 65ᵇ</cite>) the blood of a menstruant is sticky (or ill-smelling).

senses.gloss: to smear plants with rancid oil for keeping off vermin, [oth. opin.: to cover a wound in a tree with dung and tie it up.] Shebi. II, 4. Y. ib. 33ᵈ (expl. מְזַהֲמִין of Mish.) מתלעין to keep the worms off. Ib. המְזַהֵם אינו וכ׳ oiling a plant is merely like appointing a watchman (it does not advance growth). Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵃ top, v. בָּחַל II.—Part. pass. מְזוּהָם, f. מְזוּהֶמֶת ill-smelling, filthy, offensive.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 6:12">Bekh. VI, 12</cite> <he>ומז׳</he> and an animal of offensive smell or sight.

<cite ref="Berakhot 53b:33">Ber. 53ᵇ</cite> <he>מז׳</he> an offensive-looking priest. Y. Gitt. VIII, 49ᵈ top <he>מז׳ היא מלפניו</he> she is disgusting to him (on account of her conduct); a. e.—Pl. <he>מְזוּהָמִים</he>, <he>מְזוּהָמִין</he>; fem. <he>מְזוּהָמוֹת</he>. Ber. l. c. <he>ידים מ׳</he> smelling hands (after a meal, when not perfumed).
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 16:9">Lev. R. s. 16</cite>; <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 7:1">Esth. R. to III, 1</cite> <he>מה … מ׳ וכ׳</he> as ordure is offensive, so is he (the leper); a. e.

senses.gloss: to declare unfit for priestly or levitical service (or connection), to reject.
units: <cite ref="Bekhorot 47a:14">Bekh. 47ᵃ</cite> <he>אין מְזַהֲמִין וכ׳</he> the child is not rejected (as the child of a gentile).—Y. Yeb. X, 11ᵃ; XIII, 13ᵈ bot. <he>ואין ב״ד מזהמין אותה</he> but the court does not declare her unfit to marry a priest.

senses.gloss: (v. זוֹהֲמָא) part. pass. מְזוּהָם, pl. מְזוּהָמִין inclined to lasciviousness, unchaste.

to become unfit for offering through offensiveness. Pesik. Vayhi, p. 10ᵃ לא הִזְהִימוּ (perh. to be read הוּזְהָמוּ Hof.; (Yalk. Num. 713 הוזמו, expl. חוסמו, corr. acc., or הוּמָמוּ as Num. R. s. 12, end, a. e., v. Bub. note to Pesik. l. c.).
